# Function methods and implementation notes {#sec-methods}

Use these entries to check the implementation file, formal arguments, return value and documented modes for skyscapeR 2.0.9012. Each entry links to its complete help page and to the relevant methods chapter. In the argument tables, a dash marks a formal argument without a default expression. The implementation may resolve an omitted value internally. [Download the documented source build](archives/skyscapeR_2.0.9012.tar.gz).

## Time, coordinates and ephemerides {#group-time}

State the time scale, civil calendar, reference frame and refraction convention before comparing outputs. A correct calendar conversion can still pass the wrong physical instant to a downstream calculation.

- [`timestring()`](fn-timestring.qmd)

## Reducing field observations {#group-survey}

The reduced true bearing depends on which direction or solar limb was observed, when it was observed and whether a magnetic correction was supplied. A field reduction and a test of the subsequent skyline have different reference data.

- [`mag.dec()`](fn-mag-dec.qmd)
- [`reduct.compass()`](fn-reduct-compass.qmd)
- [`reduct.theodolite()`](fn-reduct-theodolite.qmd)
- [`sunAz()`](fn-sunaz.qmd)

## Terrain horizons and panoramas {#group-terrain}

Coordinate reference systems, viewpoint, vertical datum and missing terrain affect the computed skyline. Photographic calibration introduces a separate angular reference. Export, colour and image relinking have different effects from changing the numerical horizon.

- [`createHWT()`](fn-createhwt.qmd)
- [`demPalettes()`](fn-dempalettes.qmd)
- [`downloadHWT()`](fn-downloadhwt.qmd)

- [`exportPanorama()`](fn-exportpanorama.qmd)
- [`exportStellarium()`](fn-exportstellarium.qmd)
- [`hor2alt()`](fn-hor2alt.qmd)
- [`horFeature()`](fn-horfeature.qmd)
- [`importPanorama()`](fn-importpanorama.qmd)
- [`importPeakFinder()`](fn-importpeakfinder.qmd)
- [`plot.skyscapeR.horizon()`](fn-plot-skyscaper-horizon.qmd)
- [`relinkHor()`](fn-relinkhor.qmd)

## From bearings to celestial targets {#group-targets}

A target search inherits the uncertainty and coordinate conventions of the original sightline. An extreme found within a restricted bearing sector is conditional on the sector searched.

- [`zenith()`](fn-zenith.qmd)

## Stellar positions and seasonal visibility {#group-stars}

Catalogue epoch, atmosphere, skyline and a threshold-based visibility definition enter at different stages. A representative seasonal date is distinct from the time spent above the ridge on that morning.

- [`plot.skyscapeR.starphases()`](fn-plot-skyscaper-starphases.qmd)
- [`star()`](fn-star.qmd)
- [`star.phases()`](fn-star-phases.qmd)
